forbidden_promotions: caller-supplied or fitted source, pressure, amplitude, Lambda, epsilon, or coefficient data
mixing x1 states or fixed AxisData from different SchedulePressure constructions
dropping amplitude derivatives by differentiating a normalized value as if a were constant
collapsing nonzero a^2 terms into binary64
applying outer inverseL inside this raw pressure chain
complete naturalRemainder(x1), x2, fixed-point, or paper-exact claims from this pressure seam
layer.remaining_boundary: Combine this x1 source-pressure chain with raw lin2 and complete slow2, materialize the remaining angular and axial naturalRemainder(x1) branches, then execute later Picard iterates and certify fixed-point convergence, derived average/pressure, NaturalProfileAssembly, global AxisSpace bounds, and downstream paper conditions.

the common amplitude magnitude remains in signed-log metadata and no collapsed total-value binary64 projection is provided
the actual phase and amplitude chain inherits the landed numerical quadrature boundary
